status.loginHelp: Sign in from the PC's terminal (e.g. claude, codex login, agy).

add.title: Add account
add.description: Name the new {{agent}} account. You sign in with it next.

remove.title: Remove account
remove.text: Remove "{{account}}" from {{agent}}? The login for this account on this PC is deleted, and the sessions that used it go back to the main account. The account itself is not affected.

select.label: Account
select.lockedHint: Switch when the agent is done

login.title: Sign in to the account
login.openLinkPrompt: Open the link and sign in with the account you want to add
login.pcTabNote: The PC may also open a login tab; you can ignore it.
login.enterCode: Enter this code on the page
login.pasteCodePrompt: After signing in, copy the code that appears and paste it here

step.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in…
step.codeSent: Code sent. Waiting for the login to finish…

removeSession.title: Remove from app
removeSession.text: Remove this session from the app? The history stays in {{agent}}, and you can bring it back from Resume from PC.
removeSession.running: The session is working. Removing it now interrupts the work.
removeSession.awaiting_permission: The session is waiting for your permission. Removing it now interrupts the work.
removeSession.starting: The session is starting. Removing it now interrupts the start.
